summary: The change does what the retry asked for. The planner prompt, the critic prompt and the Report section of the planner brief now all require each demonstration to name its test seam. The planner prompt was shortened to make room, so the existing 500-token frame guard in lib.rs passes without being raised. The planner and critic budget lines in docs/system-facts.md now read 806 and 783 of 1300, and the budgets are unchanged. The CHANGELOG entry names the root cause and says it is fixed in the planning stage, not at one job. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` (4 passed, including both system-facts tests) and `cargo test -p athena-context` (71 passed, including the new test). I did not run the new test on the base commit, because that would need a git state change. Instead I read the base prompts and the old Report line: none of them contains "seam", so the test's first assertion would fail there. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs all passed. All five changed files are on the deliverables list; job_plan.rs and lib.rs were left untouched, which the reading allowed. I could not see the producer's own report, so its command citations are judged from Athena's recorded check that the producer left these criteria to the recorded checks. One minor issue: shortening the planner prompt slightly weakened one instruction.
